visualCharacteristics.purpose: expandable FAQ, product and pricing information panels, or a call-to-action button that reveals content

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: label cell (question or title) | panel cell (rich text, lists, links, tables); a panel cell holding only a /fragments/ link loads that fragment (so a panel can contain other blocks)

usage: FAQ lists, product and pricing information disclosures, and apply/open-account buttons that expand content.
reuseGuidance: Use faq for question lists (one answer open at a time), no-icons to hide chevrons, cta-button to render the label as a button (red / orange change its colour). For legal footnotes use accordion-disclosure.
